concepts.gloss_en: The vav component inside the letter aleph (the diagonal vav between the aleph's two yuds); distinct from the letter vav as an independent letter

reason_for_human: All 7 occurrences (in lessons 6 and 66) refer to the identical graphical component — the vav that sits inside the letter aleph (aleph = two yuds with a vav between them). The 'אות וא"ו באמצע' variant is from the very same paragraph (66_2_1) that defines the aleph as 'two yuds and a vav in the middle,' so 'in the middle' and 'within the aleph' name the same referent. This is descriptive/phrasing variation of one concept, not homographs.
